movesLabel: The five BRIEF moves, mapped to today's session

requirements.today: context is the requirement, so it comes before the work

interview.today: the grill, in rounds of questions

fresh.today: carry the spec into a new chat, not the long one

why-a-fresh-chat.description: Anthropic describes compaction as summarizing the contents and starting a new context window with the summary, warns that overly aggressive compaction can lose subtle but critical context, and recommends sub-agents with clean windows that return a condensed summary [1].

anthropic-effective-context-engineering.title: Anthropic, Effective context engineering for AI agents

callback.title: Callback
callback.script: You may have seen the freelancer Episode. You hired a freelancer who is fast, well read and tireless, and who forgets everything after each conversation. So you have to onboard that freelancer every single time, which is what the AI interview does for you.

map-to-today.title: Map to today
map-to-today.script: Here are the five letters, and today's session shows three of them. R is requirements first. I is the interview, the grill. F is the fresh chat. B, break it down, and E, evaluate each step, stay on the list, but they are not today's focus.

close.title: Close
close.script: So the second thing to take with you: move that result into a fresh chat instead of continuing the long one. To sum up: the line only runs as well as what it receives, context is the requirement, the bench has to stay clean, and the interview builds it for you. I cannot promise it fits every task, and it is early days for all of this. If you try it, I would love to hear how it went. Thank you.
